newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling stable against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling stable against dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling was stable against the dollar on Friday after a slight slide during the week and strengthened slightly against the pound sterling.
The central bank said the shilling traded at a mean commercial rate of 608.85 on Friday, unchanged from Thursday and only slightly weaker than its rate of 608.0283 on Friday last week.
The shilling traded at a mean commercial rate of 998.2127 from 1,0000.7987 on Thursday. Dealers said volume was low.
